items.description: Surat Thani is a city in Amphoe Mueang Surat Thani, Surat Thani Province, southern Thailand. It lies 651 km south of Bangkok. It is the capital of Surat Thani Province. The city has a population of 132,040, and an area of 68.97 km². The city's population density is 1,914 inhabitants per km².

items.markdown:
![Suratthani - City Guide | Planet of Hotels](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270201-1672-0139-0000-f31f0a02389f:8)
Surat Thani is `a bustling transport hub and provincial capital in southern Thailand` known primarily as the main gateway to Gulf Coast islands like [Ko Samui](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Surat-Thani/354) and Ko Pha Ngan. It sits along the Tapi River and offers visitors authentic local night markets, floating traditional vendors, and close proximity to the ancient rainforests of Khao Sok National Park.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surat_Thani) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surat_Thani)[[2]](https://www.travelfish.org/location/thailand/southern_thailand/surat_thani/surat_thani)[[3]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g297917-Surat_Thani_Surat_Thani_Province-Vacations.html)[[4]](https://www.indietraveller.co/why-you-should-visit-surat-thani/)[[5]](https://www.thailandholidaygroup.com/destinations/surat-thani/)[[6]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/surat-thani)

Key City Attractions

- **Night Markets:** Surat Thani Night Market near the city pillar shrine offers authentic local street food.
- **Floating Markets:** Pra Cha Rat and Ban Don Floating Markets showcase local handmade crafts and food vendors.
- **Ko Lamphu Park:** A peaceful public park located on a small island right in the middle of the Tapi River.
- **Khao Tha Phet:** A forested hill station with nature trails and panoramic views over the city.[](https://www.thailandholidaygroup.com/destinations/surat-thani/) 

Regional Highlights

- **Khao Sok National Park:** Home to ancient rainforests, limestone karsts, wildlife, and scenic floating raft houses on Cheow Lan Lake.
- **Island Ferries:** The primary port area connects travelers via regular ferries to Ko Samui , Ko Pha Ngan, and Ko Tao.
- **Ang Thong National Marine Park:** An archipelago of 42 pristine rainforest islands featuring hidden lagoons and hiking viewpoints.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g297917-Surat_Thani_Surat_Thani_Province-Vacations.html) [[1]](https://www.agoda.com/special-editions/thailand/southern-thailand-attractions-worth-the-visit-exploring-hidden-gems-beyond-the-headlines/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DPX4TKvEeD0/)

items.title: What is the history of Surat Thani?

expanded_element.title: Surat Thani - Guide Thailand - Sawa discovery
expanded_element.snippet: History of Surat Thani in Thailand In ancient times, the city of Surat Thani was called "Bandon," meaning "high village." In 1915, when King Rama VI (Vajiravudh) ascended the throne, he changed the name of the locality to "Surat Thani," meaning "city of virtuous people."
